04Experience

Where I have worked

Full experience & education

  1. 07/2022 – present

    Software Engineer

    Cognity · Athens, Greece

    • Analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and customization of enterprise Order & Service Management (OSM) solutions on Oracle Communications OSM and WebLogic, including specialised testing.
    • Development and customization of complex telecommunications service orchestration and fulfillment flows: order decomposition, provisioning, resource reservation, shipping and service activation.
    • Design and implementation of XQuery/XML-based business logic, integrations, data transformations and OSM workflows.
    • Oracle OSM
    • XQuery
    • XML
    • Java
    • Spring Boot
    • Camunda
    • +14

  2. 02/2022 – 06/2022

    Back-End Developer

    INDUST Systems · Patras, Greece

    • Cloud development services on the IoT platform IoTControl, to improve efficiency and reduce energy consumption on production lines.
    • AI-enabled app for product quality control during the pasteurization process, in the European research project zPasteurAIzer.
    • Industrial IoT controllers based on RaspberryPi for the zPasteurAIzer project: receiving production process signals, data pre-processing, sending data to the cloud server, receiving commands from the web services and executing orders in industrial automation.
    • Python
    • TypeScript
    • JavaScript
    • NestJS
    • TypeORM
    • Docker
    • +6
